head: governance/delegated-experiment-review-2026-11-10
title: T02/T07 v1.2: delegated data and experimental-readiness review after researcher authorization

comments.body:
Researcher authorization recorded (2026-11-10, America/New_York): “I approve the proposed experimental authorization for E1–E4 on the eligible subset of the 11 GenBank and 10 iGEM constructs, subject to all stated evidence, safety, rights, resource and protocol conditions. I authorize ChatGPT to perform delegated evidence review and clear eligible stages once PR #9 is merged.”

The exact decision and non-waivable conditions are committed in `docs/oversight/2026-11-10_RESEARCHER_EXPERIMENT_AUTHORIZATION.md` on this PR branch. **This is permission to use the new review workflow after merge, not a `CLEAR_FOR_E1/E2/E3/E4` record.** PR #9 still must merge, Codex must prepare verified source/label/independence evidence, and ChatGPT must issue the stage-specific clearance before any new scored experiments. No new datasets, spending, or public release authorized.
